scope: Actual installed 0.5.0 multi-element functionality; not aerodynamic validation
high_re_policy: Retain released Re/Mach guards; record Re=6e6 as unsupported, not as simulated
geometry: NACA0012, generated by supplied aero2d geometry code only; no aero2d flow solver runs
cases: Slotted flap: chord parameter 0.3, deflection 20 deg, gap parameter 0.04, overlap 0
Double-slot: additional vane chord parameter 0.1, deflection 10 deg, gap parameter 0.04
Fowler: same flap settings, geometry generator's Fowler cove

numerical_case.wall: Stationary no slip, linear Bouzidi; record fallback links and mass leakage

checks: DAT/project roundtrip and shared coordinates; nonintersecting polygons; full assembly chord/reference
Actual minimum polygon gaps, gap/dx, solid counts and discrete solid separation at 32/64 and planned 48/96
Each boundary present, owned links intersect its contour, isotropic-pressure loads cancel per body and overall
Actual refined slotted run, finite coefficients, diagnostics and independent budget closure
Reflected geometry and alpha: same Cd, opposite Cl/Cm over the first 32 steps
Actual stopped/resumed slotted case: exact history and residual CSV prefix versus uninterrupted run
Actual refined double-slot and Fowler short runs; actual uniform slotted short run
Real multi-contour field export, finite gap fluid values, CSV/PNG/GIF, loaded-result GUI
Offline Python connections/DNS disabled; test installed wheel; no release-source changes without a demonstrated defect

fixed_tolerances.wall_intersection_fraction_position: must bracket actual polygon boundary at +/- 1e-6 link

limits: Rough grid, short startup, compact domain/span; not resolution/statistical convergence
No tunnel data for this exact generated assembly currently bundled; physical validation not performed
Two Reynolds numbers must not be confused: functionality at 1e4 is not a result at 6e6
Native Windows and GPU are separate checks; Linux evidence must not be relabeled
